narrative.overview: A field report laid over documentary roofing work: mineral green, warm paper, square ruled geometry, and decisive safety-lime action.

rules.name: The Proof and Action Rule
rules.body: Lime means act or notice verified proof; copper means focus, contact, or the closing transition.

rules.name: The One Structural Voice Rule
rules.body: Display type states the thesis and section claims; body type explains and attributes.

dos: Do keep public facts and demo disclosures visible.
Do attribute every review excerpt directly.
donts: Don't display the aggregate Google score.
Don't represent illustrative photography as company project work.
